milestone.name: lightweight tag does not inherit signed-tag origin
milestone.revision: A lightweight tag has no annotated tag object to verify. In the live requests release, the tag therefore fails PROVIDER_VERIFIED_ANNOTATED_TAG even though its exact target commit independently passes PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT. This preserves a critical distinction: source-state authenticity may be available while release-name/tag-intent authenticity is not.
